articles.summary: Company also declares preferred stock dividend MCLEAN, Va. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 3, 2026-- Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF) today announced a quarterly dividend of $0.80 per common share payable March 2, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on February 19, 2026.
articles.title: Capital One Announces Quarterly Dividend
